title: Integrate one application-owned bridge host state into normal desktop lifecycle

implementation.normalModeConstruction: one LWBridgeControlPipeHostState per desktop window/application lifetime
implementation.isolatedProbeModes: no bridge host owner is constructed
implementation.registryOwnership: one LWBridgeControlPipeRegistry owned by the shared host state
implementation.profileLifecycle: OverviewLifecycleService receives the host by reference and does not own/stop it
implementation.backend: LWBridgeBackend receives the same host by reference for future status/call routing
implementation.stoppedGuard: RequireActiveRegistry fails with BRIDGE_STOPPED after application host shutdown

coverage: profile lifecycle borrows host without stopping it
backend borrows the exact same host
LWBridgeWindow source guard pins construction, dependency injection and profile-before-host shutdown order

reasonForBoundary: The source-backed ownership problem is now resolved, but exact native listener I/O and route/pending-call lifecycles must be implemented and tested before opening the production pipe or enabling call_lua(getStatus).
